messages.subject: Helmsworth dispute - instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the Helmsworth plant problem. The HC-450 has been a disaster - four breakdowns in four months and we reckon we're £1.4m out of pocket between hire-in, repairs and lost production.

Can you get the ball rolling? Linda has the contract and the breakdown logs.

Geoffrey

messages.subject: RE: Helmsworth dispute - instructing you
messages.plaintextBody:
Geoffrey,

Thank you - good to speak. I'm pleased to confirm we'll act. Tom Gallagher will have day-to-day conduct under my supervision. I attach our engagement letter setting out scope and fees; please sign and return the copy.

Our first step will be a letter of claim under the construction pre-action protocol once we've reviewed the contract and the logs. Could Paul send over the breakdown reports and weighbridge records?

Best,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
